items.h: Big four pass on the November hike; no variable rates under 6%
items.p: CBA, Westpac, NAB, ANZ lift variable rates 0.25pt from 13 Nov (6.49-6.59%). Lowest advertised owner-occupier variable 6.14%.

items.h: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85% (6-3 vote)
items.p: Fifth hike of 2026; tightening bias dropped. Next meeting 8 Dec.

items.h: Cotality: Perth -1.7% in October, -5.7% over the quarter
items.p: Perth 8.9% below April 2026 peak; capital-city days on market 39, discounting 4.7%.
